hints.title: Prefix Tree Guided Grid Search
hints.text: Searching for multiple target words simultaneously across a 2D character matrix can quickly repeat redundant path explorations if conducted word by word.

hints.title: Trie Node Guided Pruning Invariant
hints.text: Step onto a cell only if its character exists as a child of the current prefix tree node. Clear the word marker upon collection to avoid duplicate matches.

hints.title: Backtracking Grid Traversal Procedure
hints.text: Insert all words into a prefix tree. For each grid cell, initiate depth-first traversal tracking the current tree node. Mark visited cells with a sentinel character to prevent reuse, recurse to orthogonal neighbors matching next letters, and restore cell contents on retreat. Prune leaf nodes on backtracking.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(M * N * 4^L) time and O(total words length) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running individual DFS searches for each of W words yields O(W * M * N * 4^L), timing out on dense character grids.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A shared prefix tree compresses common prefixes, bounding worst-case traversal to O(M * N * 4^L) with tree space proportional to total word characters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate must integrate prefix tree node transitions directly into grid DFS and deregister matched words to avoid duplicate outputs.
